data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Privy authentication and embedded wallets on iOS and Android
data.what_it_does: Provides phone, email, passkey, OAuth, SIWE/SIWS login, and non‑custodial Ethereum/Solana wallet creation and transaction signing. It also manages session restoration and MFA.
use_when: You need multi‑factor authentication with phone or email OTP
You want to embed a non‑custodial wallet in your Flutter app
You need OAuth login with Google, Apple, Twitter, or Discord
avoid_when: You only need simple email/password auth
You are building a web‑only app without native SDKs
strengths: Native SDK integration for fast auth and wallet ops
Supports multiple auth methods and MFA
Handles session restoration and network changes
weaknesses: Requires native platform setup (App ID, URL schemes)
Limited to iOS 17+ and Android API 27+
No code generation or declarative UI components
data.setup_notes: Add privy_flutter to pubspec, configure App ID and Client ID in Privy dashboard, set URL schemes in Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml, call Privy(config) in Dart

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Google OAuth only, simpler for single provider

alternatives.name: local_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers biometric auth without external service

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Full auth suite with email/password, phone, OAuth, and backend
